cover_prompt: Full-color illustration, warm cozy cottagecore aesthetic, premium coloring book cover artwork. An elegant Victorian tea party scene set in a lush conservatory garden. A kawaii bunny in a frilly Victorian dress and lace bonnet sits at an ornate wrought-iron garden table pouring tea from a gilded floral teapot into a dainty porcelain cup. The table is laden with a tiered silver cake stand holding decorated scones and petit fours, a crystal jam pot, a bowl of clotted cream, and a vase of pink roses. The setting features arched glass conservatory windows with climbing wisteria, a vintage birdcage with a singing bird, an ornamental stone fountain in the background, and potted ferns and hydrangeas lining the path. Warm golden afternoon light filters through the glass, casting soft shadows. Rich saturated colors in dusty rose, sage green, cream, and gold tones. Whimsical cute style with large expressive eyes, inviting and relaxing Victorian afternoon tea atmosphere. NO text in the image.
